title: **Title:** Shift Happens: New Rule Alert!
script:
**Title:** "Shift Happens: New Rule Alert!"

**Script:**

(Upbeat background music starts playing. The host, a lively and energetic person, appears on screen with a friendly smile.)

Host: "Hey everyone! We've got a update that's about to change the game!"

Key Point 1: "From now on, AI-generated posts and comments are NOT allowed!"

Key Point 2: "We want to keep our community authentic and real, so let's keep it human!"

Key Point 3: "This means no more auto-generated replies or posts – it's time to get creative!"

Key Point 4: "Let's make this a great community, together!"

(Closing shot with a call-to-action to engage with the community.)
